BA.rationale: Boeing is a deeply challenged company with poor fundamental health and trajectory. Q1 2026 showed revenue of $22.2B (+14% YoY) but the company remains unprofitable with a GAAP net loss of -$7M and EPS of -$0.11. Operating cash flow was negative at -$179M, and free cash flow was -$1.5B. The balance sheet is severely strained with total equity of only $5.99B against $46.96B in debt, yielding a debt-to-equity ratio of 7.84x. Commercial Airplanes, the largest segment, still operates at a -6.1% operating margin. While Defense and Global Services show improvement, the overall margin structure is weak with gross margin at 4.8% and operating margin at 4.6%. The company is in a multi-year turnaround with execution risk on 737 production ramp and 777X certification. Valuation is extremely stretched at a P/E of ~80x and P/B of 30x despite persistent losses. The stock has declined -4.2% over the past quarter and is trading near the middle of its 52-week range. Near-term catalysts like potential China orders are speculative and already partially priced in. The combination of poor fundamentals, stretched valuation, and execution risk makes this unattractive.
